items.q: can you remember the time when you were playing with Ivan Thomas, when he was murdered? Yeah, sure.

ctx.x: So, okay, can you remember the time when you were playing with Ivan Thomas, when he was murdered? Yeah, sure. Can you tell us something about that? One thing I'd like to know is, can you remember any of the other people in the band? Yeah. Pomp. Pomp. Changer. Bruce Robinson, the piano. Walter Preston playing banjo. Chani on the drum. Steve Antonis. Uh-huh. And a young footballer named Al was playing tennis. Uh-huh. Those old boys were in that band at that time. He didn't have a bass player? No, he was using two…

items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: Because after Evan Thomas got killed, Bunk taking the job over, we had a couple of jobs to play, and we only used one trumpet.

ctx.x: Because after Evan Thomas got killed, Bunk taking the job over, we had a couple of jobs to play, and we only used one trumpet. The Bunk was playing fine, but after he lost his teeth and had laid off for that many years, and ten years made him ten years older. That would make some difference. That would make a lot of difference.
